decisions.decision: Joanne Brazell, who works in the Meal Site on Mondays, will fill the Outreach Coordinator position until Outreach Coordinator Faith Anderson returns from medical leave.
decisions.quote: joanne brazell, who works in the meal site on mondays, will be filling in at this position until faith returns.

decisions.decision: Ms. Brown will present the COA Bylaw changes at the May meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Outreach payroll will come strictly from Formula Grant funds until end of FY13, and another $7400 is expected to be transferred into the Outreach line before FY13 ends.
budget_items.quote: it is expected that another $7400 will be transferred into the outreach line before the end of this fiscal year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: More funds were needed to be transferred into the Santa Buckley Energy line due to higher heating costs at the senior center from the harsh winter.
budget_items.quote: more funds needed to be transferred into the santa buckley energy line.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager will recommend moving all COA utility costs into a Central Purchasing account with the Town in FY14.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has informed the coa director that she will be recommending that all coa utility costs be transferred into a "central purchasing" account with the town in fy14.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reduced the COA FY14 recommended budget by a stated amount because utilities will move to a Central Purchasing fund.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has reduce d the coa fy14 recommended budget by$6-8k due to the fact that the all utilities will be moved to a central purchasing fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Hays asked whether $1200 would be included in the COA budget for the copy machine maintenance contract, previously paid by Supporters of the Eagle House; Ms. Noble replied yes.
budget_items.quote: questioned whether or not $1200 will be in cluded in the coa budget to cover the copy machine maintenance contract.

budget_items.topic: Town Finance Committee extra Outreach funds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Extra funds in the Outreach line were approved at the Town Finance Committee meeting, per Ms. Noble's report.
budget_items.quote: that extra funds in the outreach line were approved.

budget_items.topic: Meal Site Manager Serve Safe course reimbursement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Meal Site Manager paid for an online Serve Safe/Food Safety course with a personal credit card and will not be reimbursed until the course is completed.
budget_items.quote: also, she will not be reimbursed for the course until it is completed.
